title: A Modern Functional Analytic Tour of the Fourier-Bessel Transform
summary: In this paper, we review the theory of the Fourier--Bessel transform. The Fourier--Bessel transform is an integral transform on the half-line that generalizes the Fourier cosine transform and is dependent upon a parameter $ν> -1$. Many of the standard results for the Fourier--Bessel transform have become folklore results and are difficult to find single sources for or predate modern functional analysis and instead rely on hard analysis techniques that miss the elegance of more modern machinery.
